title: H-REFRESHSEAT-1: a PARTNER'S furniture edit on the CLIENT'S FAST FOOD (fx-hq1 '11 ba:street_tenthavenue') while the owner is inside simulating. LEG 1 the host repaints the table a diner sits at (a CORE change -> the owner's refresh destroys + respawns it): the diners there leave the game's own shop-closing way (InstantlyLeave) BEFORE the destroy, no NullReferenceException in SeatSpot / ResetItemsInTable, no leaked seat. LEG 2 the host repaints the till a queue stands at: the queuers move to another line or leave (the game's station-lost-worker path). Review folds (R1/R2): fx-hq1's fast food has ONE till (StaffDiag tills=1), so LEGS 3-4 use the HOST'S clothing store (${shop2}, tills=2 STAFFED at h11; the host owns and simulates it, the CLIENT is the partner who paints). LEG 3 the partner repaints the busier of two queued tills: its queuers move to the OTHER till (lastRel=<moved>/<left>/<cancelled> with moved >= 1, left 0), none on a dead line. LEG 4 the partner repaints BOTH tills in ONE delta: nobody moves onto a line killed in the same refresh (moved 0) and 10 s later no live customer waits in a line whose item is gone (deadLineQ=0, leakLine=0). No slot-machine fixture exists (not exercised). Money / stock oracles on the owner after each leg. NO save.
preconditions: Reporter fixture session fx-hq1 (day 44, MERGED - vars.keepMerger true). Dev build with H-REFRESHSEAT-1 (itemedit, custstate pick, custstate held released=, BAMP_DEV). Set-up as T-HANDOFFSEAT (both outside, one consensus skip to 10:45, the owner enters first and simulates, the host follows). A premise never reached (no seated diner / no queue) SKIPS that leg's assertions via `premise do`, never a fail; handoffbook / stockdelta are never wrapped. `custstate held` released=<seated>/<walking>/<other>/<queue moved>/<queue left> are this machine's cumulative ReleaseHoldersOf tallies. ORACLE NOTE: NullReferenceException carries the `(?<!swallowed )` lookbehind (fx-hq1's own Gley diagnostic).
oracles_absent: \[Handoff\] (capture|capture live|apply|apply visit|stream|exit snapshot|take-over|wait tick|final received|citizen|leave|send final)\b[^:]*:
